# ContextVault v1.3.0

## What's new

### Free and Pro plan entitlements
- Free supports one indexed project root at a time and up to 1,000 eligible files per project.
- Pro removes project-count and eligible-file limits.
- The MCP tools `index_project` and `search_context` require a verified Pro license.
- Live Monitoring requires a verified Pro license.
- Free file-count limits are checked before indexing is accepted and again inside the indexing pipeline.
- Settings explain the active plan, limits, and Pro capabilities. Verified license activation refreshes plan state without requiring an application restart.

### Local-first code context
- Project scanning, embedding generation with Ollama, semantic search, and SQLite index storage run locally.
- Compatible local MCP clients can retrieve indexed context through `index_project` and `search_context`.
- The MCP search tool supports an optional `filter` value: `code` (default), `docs`, or `all`.

## Requirements
- Node.js 22.13 or newer.
- Ollama with the `nomic-embed-text` model.
- Local ContextVault installation and SQLite storage.
- For MCP integration: a desktop client capable of launching a local stdio MCP server. The documented clients are Claude Desktop and Cursor.
- A verified Pro license for MCP integration and Live Monitoring.

## Installation
Download and extract the GitHub source archive, then follow the platform-specific installation and MCP setup instructions in [README_MCP.md](https://github.com/ahmedfayedesmail-ui/contextvault/blob/main/README_MCP.md).

The repository includes installer scripts for Windows, macOS, and Linux. This release does not attach a signed MSI or a self-contained offline installer. Initial setup requires an internet connection for dependencies and the Ollama model.

## Privacy
Indexing and embeddings use local Ollama and local SQLite. Code snippets returned to a connected AI client may be processed by that provider under its own terms and data-handling settings.

## Validation
GitHub Actions CI must pass on both Ubuntu and Windows for the exact tagged commit. Clean-machine installation and manual MCP end-to-end validation remain separate manual checks; this release does not claim those manual scenarios were completed.
